explanation: getclamstatus is a compiled PyInstaller binary with no recoverable source in this bundle. Its behavior is inferred only from call sites and output: clam.sh invokes it with the ClamAV scan output, and it writes onegrid_infectedStatus/athgateway_infectedStatus into cmd_out.xml as a STRING like 'Infected files: N'. There is no separate raw-evidence file to independently verify this against -- the tag it writes is the only available signal. See attack_clam_malware for the attack-status/value-meaning view of the same mechanism.

metadata.verification_role: none possible -- tag is the only signal, must be trusted or flagged as unverifiable

value_meanings.Infected files: 0: Clean -- zero infected files on the last clamscan run.
value_meanings.Infected files: N (N>=1): N infected files found -- getclamstatus just relays clamscan's count verbatim into this string, it doesn't add its own severity classification.
